column3: The Hebrew names many islands; BSB says distant shores.
The Hebrew has cloud in the singular; BSB has clouds.
The Hebrew has completed verbs for illuminating, seeing, and trembling; BSB has present verbs.
The Hebrew describes melting as completed; BSB uses melt.
The Hebrew has completed verbs of proclaiming and seeing; BSB has present verbs.
The Hebrew has a carved image in the singular; BSB has images.
The Hebrew names Judah’s daughters rather than towns and uses completed verbs of hearing and rejoicing.
The Hebrew says light is sown; BSB says shines.
The Hebrew names the remembrance of His holiness; BSB says His holy name.
